  // clang-format off
  //.............................................................................
  // @key    CmdElementSelected
  // @usage  put this code block into the function Cmd::AfterElementSelected()
  // @brief  After Element Selected
  // @brief  !Discard. Replaced by CMD ACTION FIA
  //.............................................................................
  // Field count = 4
  switch (field) {
  case Field_KtCourseGuardCmd_Origin:
      if (parameter->Origin == spiSpecOnSelection)
      {
          _ktcHSO.RemoveElement(pPathElement);
          parameter->Origin = NULL_var;
      }
      else
      {
          _ktcHSO.RemoveElement(parameter->Origin);
          parameter->Origin = spiSpecOnSelection;
      }
      break;
  case Field_KtCourseGuardCmd_Targets:
      if (parameter->Targets.Locate(spiSpecOnSelection) == 0)
      {
          parameter->Targets.Append(spiSpecOnSelection);
      }
      else
      {
          _ktcHSO.RemoveElement(pPathElement);
          parameter->Targets.RemoveValue(spiSpecOnSelection);
      }
      break;
  case Field_KtCourseGuardCmd_Multi:
      if (parameter->Multi.Locate(spiSpecOnSelection) == 0)
      {
          parameter->Multi.Append(spiSpecOnSelection);
      }
      else
      {
          _ktcHSO.RemoveElement(pPathElement);
          parameter->Multi.RemoveValue(spiSpecOnSelection);
      }
      break;
  case Field_KtCourseGuardCmd_View:
      if (parameter->View == spiSpecOnSelection)
      {
          _ktcHSO.RemoveElement(pPathElement);
          parameter->View = NULL_var;
      }
      else
      {
          _ktcHSO.RemoveElement(parameter->View);
          parameter->View = spiSpecOnSelection;
      }
      break;
  }
